correctness.rationale: For equal separately normalized boundary-circle Hardy masses, Laurent basis e_n=z^n/sqrt(1+R^(2n)) is orthonormal. Compression gives the bilateral k-shift weights w_n=(A+B R^(2n+k))/sqrt((1+R^(2n))(1+R^(2n+2k))). For k>0 the selfcommutator diagonal entries are f(q²s)-f(s), with f(t)=(a+2ct+bt²)/(1+(q+q^-1)t+t²). Independent exact symbolic algebra verified the stated factorization as a positive prefactor times a linear polynomial in s. Since s ranges a two-sided geometric tail to zero and infinity, positivity iff da>=2c>=db. Cauchy--Schwarz makes da>=2c redundant whenever 2c>=db, yielding the disk |B-A/d|<=|A|/d; adjoint reverses roles for k<0. Two-sided geometric tail decay proves C in every S_p>0, and telescoping proves tr C=k(a-b). Both tail coefficients zero imply only A=B=0 is normal. No finite diagnostic stands in for these infinite claims.
